purpose: Teach: 薪/館内/本館/防音/農作業/手洗い/補習/弾ける

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行、宿の前に、薪、積んであった。
lines.en: On the school trip—there was firewood stacked up in front of the inn.
lines.style: Light, observational opening. Quick pace, eager to share. Slight brightness on 'firewood'—noticing small details. Natural teen energy, no performance.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。博物館、館内ガイド、丁寧だった。
lines.en: Yeah. The museum guide inside was really thorough.
lines.style: Genuine agreement, following along naturally. Warm but measured tone. Eyes somewhere in the middle distance—not performing interest, actually present.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本館の階段、登るのに疲れた。
lines.en: The stairs in the main building wore me out climbing them.
lines.style: Dry, understated complaint wrapped in humour. A small smile underneath. Not whining—just matter-of-fact weariness. Slight shrug in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 家、防音、ちゃんとしてないから、隣の音、丸聞こえ。
lines.en: Our place doesn't have proper soundproofing—you can hear everything from the neighbours.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost rueful observation. Slower pace. No resentment, just stating what is. The tone of someone noticing small inconveniences about their own life without dwelling.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 実家の農作業、手伝うって、長期休みに、約束した。
lines.en: I promised to help with the farm work back home over the long break.
lines.style: Sincere, grounded commitment. No flourish. Steady, responsible tone. The voice of someone who keeps her word without making a show of it. Slight weight to the delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 手洗いの徹底、まだ続いてるよね、コロナ以来。
lines.en: We're still doing the strict hand-washing thing—hasn't stopped since COVID.
lines.style: Practical observation, almost conversational. Low-key tone, no drama. The rhythm of someone stating an ordinary habit that's become invisible. Light pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I've got summer remedial classes too.
lines.style: Quiet, resigned admission. Slight downturn at the end. Not self-pitying—just tired of the fact. The tone of someone sharing minor bad news without asking for sympathy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭、シャボン玉、たくさん弾けるのが、楽しかった。
lines.en: The festival was fun—there were so many bubbles popping everywhere.
lines.style: Genuine warmth and pleasure in the memory. Lighter tempo, small lift at 'popping'. Unguarded for a moment—the honest brightness underneath the sarcasm. Ends with real satisfaction.
